begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition reachable where
  "reachable s \<equiv> \<exists>js. s \<in> execution A s0 js"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition Step where
  "Step a \<equiv> {(s,s') . s' \<in> execution A s [a]}"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition obs_det where
  "obs_det \<equiv> \<forall>s js. (\<exists>s'. execution A s js = {s'})"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemmas obs_detD = obs_det_def[THEN meta_eq_to_obj_eq, THEN iffD1, rule_format]<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition no_abs where
  "no_abs \<equiv> \<forall>x s as . reachable s
                       \<longrightarrow> x \<in> steps (Simulation.Step A) (Init A s) as
                       \<longrightarrow> Init A (Fin A x) = {x}"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemmas no_absD = no_abs_def[THEN meta_eq_to_obj_eq, THEN iffD1, rule_format]<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>Enabled system\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>text\<open>
  A system that is always enabled.

  In particular, the system will never be in deadlock, and there
  is always an enabled transition from every reachable state.\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>locale enabled_system = system +
  assumes enabled: "(\<exists>js. s \<in> execution A s0 js) \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>s'. s' \<in> execution A s js"

  fixes uwr :: "'d \<Rightarrow> ('s \<times> 's) set"  (* unwinding relation *)
  fixes policy :: "('d \<times> 'd) set"     (* who can send info to whom *)

  assumes schedIncludesCurrentDom:
    "(s,t) \<in> uwr schedDomain \<Longrightarrow> dom e s = dom e t"
  assumes schedFlowsToAll:
    "(schedDomain,d) \<in> policy"
  assumes schedNotGlobalChannel:
    "(x,schedDomain) \<in> policy \<Longrightarrow> x = schedDomain"
